## `Icons` { #icons-static-class }

`public static class Icons`

Material Icons font icon constants. Each constant is an IconDef pairing the unicode glyph with the font name. Usage: `Icon(Icons.Home).TextColor(0xFFFFFFFF)`

Font file: Assets/Fonts/MaterialIcons-Regular.ttf



Full icon list: https://fonts.google.com/icons



Devs can add more icon fonts (FontAwesome, Phosphor, etc.) by dropping the .ttf in Assets/Fonts/ and creating their own constants class.
